parameters.query: =SELECT nome,objetivo,pode,nao_pode,ferramentas,prompt_sistema,status,teste_ok,config FROM general_agentes WHERE nome='{{ String($json.body.agent || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' LIMIT 1;

={{ $json.falha ? 'SELECT 0 AS id WHERE FALSE;' : "INSERT INTO general_artifacts (task_id,agent_name,tipo,conteudo) VALUES ('" + $json.task_id + "','" + String($json.agent).replace(/'/g, "''") + "','" + $json.acao + "','" + $json.conteudo_esc + "') RETURNING id;" }}
=SELECT id, length(conteudo) AS len FROM general_artifacts WHERE id = {{ Number($json.id || 0) }} AND task_id = '{{ $('Preparar Artefato').first().json.task_id }}';
